controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - Le 11 fevrier 2026, accord avec le BIS pour clore une enquete sur des livraisons a des clients chinois : 253 M$ payes integralement au T2 fiscal 2026, audits internes et formation conformite
controles.verbatim_source: on February 11, 2026, we entered into a settlement agreement with the U.S. Commerce Department Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) to resolve its inquiry relating to certain China customer shipments and export controls compliance and agreed to pay BIS an amount of $ 253 million, which we paid in full during our second quarter of fiscal 2026. The settlement agreement with BIS requires us to conduct internal audits of our export controls compliance program and maintain export compliance training and reporting mechanisms.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - Le dossier est solde (formulation de l'ATT : 'Le dossier est solde et le montant absorbe sans difficulte')
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 (12 dec. 2025) : 'since 2022, we have received multiple subpoenas from government authorities requesting information relating to certain China customer shipments and export controls compliance, including from the U.S. Department of Justice, the U.S. Commerce Department Bureau of Industry and Security and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. We are cooperating fully with the U.S. government in these matters.' ; 10-Q T2 FY2026 : seul le volet BIS est declare resolu, et 'Any inquiries we may receive are subject to uncertainties, and we cannot predict the outcome of any governmental inquiries or proceedings that may occur.' Le 10-K FY2025 mentionne en outre des subpoenas DOJ distincts sur 'certain federal award applications and information submitted to the federal government'. Aucun document ne declare closes les procedures DOJ et SEC.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : 'Le volet BIS est solde et le montant absorbe sans difficulte, mais les demandes du DOJ et de la SEC portant sur le meme sujet (livraisons en Chine et conformite export), mentionnees dans le 10-K FY2025, ne sont declarees closes par aucun document.'

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - L'accord inclut un denial order suspendu, leve trois ans apres l'ordre s'il n'y a aucun manquement
controles.verbatim_source: The settlement agreement also includes a denial order that is suspended and will be waived three years after the date of the order issued under the settlement agreement, provided that we have timely completed the audit requirements.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision facultative : la condition exacte de levee est 'avoir mene a bien dans les delais les obligations d'audit', pas 'aucun manquement' au sens large. La rubrique ce_qui_affaiblirait de l'ATT enonce deja la condition correcte.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - Tout manquement aux termes de l'accord pourrait reactiver l'interdiction d'exporter certains produits hors des Etats-Unis
controles.verbatim_source: Our failure to comply with the terms of the settlement agreement could result in significant penalties, including the loss of the suspension of the denial order which would prohibit us from exporting certain of our products outside of the United States.

controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE - Le gouvernement americain continue d'emettre de nouvelles exigences de licences qui limitent encore davantage les ventes
controles.verbatim_source: The U.S. government continues to issue new export licensing requirements, and additional updates and other requirements that have had the effect of further limiting our ability to provide certain products and services to customers outside the U.S., including in China.
